title.v: Cập nhật lại quyển chứng từ

items.key: status = '1' and (ngay_ph is null or ngay_ph <= case when replace('{$%c[tu_ngay]}', ' ', '') = '//' then '' else convert(smalldatetime, '{$%c[tu_ngay]}', 103) end) and ma_nk in (select ma_nk from v20dmctnk b where ma_ct in (select distinct ma_ct from dmct8) and not exists(select 1 from v20dmctnk c where c.ma_nk = b.ma_nk and c.ma_ct not in (select distinct ma_ct from dmct8)) and ('{$%c[ma_ct]}' = '' or dbo.ff_ExactInlist(ma_ct, '{$%c[ma_ct]}') = 1))

command.text:
declare @field varchar(max) = '', @message nvarchar(max) = '' exec zrs_VoucherBookUpdate @tu_ngay, @den_ngay, @ma_quyen, @ma_ct, @ma_quyen_blank, @ma_dvcs, 2, @@language, @@userID, @@admin, @ma_quyen_p, @field out, @message out if @message <> '' begin select @field as field, @message as message return end
select '' as field, '' as message, 'active$&SysID;$Complete(this);' as script return;
